rv.q: "Any Rebellion of Will" is humanistic and moving.
Any Rebellion of Will is so fast-paced and funny, both wryly and laugh-out-loud, that it’s easy to elide over the sadness at its core.
Any Rebellion of Will is a joyous inversion of well-loved theatrical moves, the kind of theater that shines in a little back-alley space like Trap Door.
Any Rebellion of Will is a production that embraces the strange, sometimes to its advantage and sometimes to its detriment.

cn.t: Daniels's absurdist comedy earns strong praise for its irreverent take on kitchen-sink drama, though its bewildering chaos may divide audiences between those who embrace its bizarre humor and those baffled by the madness.
